show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Bill Trenchard - First Round Capital (Manager Meetings, EP.23)
summary:
Bill joined first round after starting five companies and led first round's investments in Uber,
flexport and lending home. But in the venture world, you have these resonating relationships
that go on and on and they become particularly important because the evaluation horizons
are so long. Got to do some really cool investments there, the most notable one being Uber,
which was obviously a fantastic outcome.

thesis: The discussion centers on the evolution of First Round Capital from a small group of investors into a mature firm with 75 employees dedicated to platform initiatives, investing, and content production. The speakers argue that the firm's durability stems from a strong culture driven by founder Josh Koppelman, who operates as a 'fund entrepreneur' rather than a traditional investor, ensuring that new hires act as culture carriers.
